caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a green artificial-turf putting surface, where a transparent vertical plastic tube stands over a hole whose white liner shows at its base. Behind the tube, a tan brick wall frames pink and red flowers at the center, white blossoms on the right, and pink blooms on the left. The tube's surface reflects the turf, and camera framing stays constant throughout. Within the tube, a white dimpled golf ball is absent early on, then appears low near the liner. When visible it rises through the middle toward the top edge of the visible region. At certain moments the ball vanishes, the interior reading as empty before it reappears at a comparable height. The ball thus flickers in and out without any visible descent, the motion neither settling nor concluding.
